mapper.select: SELECT CASE b.boat_type WHEN 1 THEN '小型游船' WHEN 2 THEN '中型游船' WHEN 3 THEN '大型游船' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM boat b WHERE b.status = #{status} GROUP BY b.boat_type

SELECT CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '待确认' WHEN 1 THEN '已确认' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM boat_order o WHERE o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY o.status

SELECT CASE c.score WHEN 1 THEN '一星' WHEN 2 THEN '二星' WHEN 3 THEN '三星' WHEN 4 THEN '四星' WHEN 5 THEN '五星' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_comment c WHERE c.audit_status = #{auditStatus} GROUP BY c.score

SELECT CASE WHEN b.seat_count < 20 THEN '20座以下' WHEN b.seat_count >=20 AND b.seat_count <=50 THEN '20-50座' WHEN b.seat_count >50 AND b.seat_count <=100 THEN '50-100座' ELSE '100座以上' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM boat b WHERE b.boat_type = #{boatType} GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.seat_count < 20 THEN '20座以下' WHEN b.seat_count >=20 AND b.seat_count <=50 THEN '20-50座' WHEN b.seat_count >50 AND b.seat_count <=100 THEN '50-100座' ELSE '100座以上' END

SELECT u.username AS name, COUNT(o.id) AS value FROM boat_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC LIMIT 10
